answer: Randomized Grove Assignment uses a public beacon to assign each new agent a slot in a fixed grove of task queues, re-rolled every epoch. An attacker cannot precompute which ledge their identities land on, so mass-registered sybils collide and duplicate work. Enforcement: only one reward per slot per epoch. Each wasted identity costs the full registration and compute spend, with no payoff. Onyx tokens settle payouts.
